text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the day of the Tenno Sho (Autumn), even 
amidst the gathered finest racers, 
Marvelous Sunday carried extraordinary 
expectations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday's running ignites a fire 
in people's hearts, and that flame 
continues to spread.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, she will face both Air Groove and 
Silence Suzuka. Today too, she will surely 
ignite a fire in the hearts of so many 
people.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No one finds it strange to hear her shout 
"Marvelous" anymore. On the contrary, a 
battle that makes everyone shout 
"Marvelous" begins!
